name: warp-common-skills
description: Fork of warpdotdev/common-skills packaged as a multi-tool plugin marketplace: curated bundle plugins (engineering, productivity, misc), pocockless variants that drop skills overlapping mattpocock-skills, and warp-all.

plugins.name: warp-engineering
plugins.description: All Warp dev-workflow skills: specs, PRs, CI triage, merge conflicts, autonomous implementation.

plugins.name: warp-productivity
plugins.description: Research, readout documents, and multi-agent council/critique skills.

plugins.name: warp-misc
plugins.description: Meta and internal skills: brand assets, skill authoring, skill-doctor, agent feedback channels.

plugins.name: warp-engineering-pocockless
plugins.description: warp-engineering minus skills that overlap mattpocock-skills (code-review, resolving-merge-conflicts).

plugins.name: warp-productivity-pocockless
plugins.description: warp-productivity minus the research skill, which overlaps mattpocock-skills.

plugins.name: warp-all
plugins.description: Every skill in this fork of warpdotdev/common-skills, in one plugin.
